# Erica Thompson

> Fractional CTO and technical educator. Self-taught, staff-level engineer
> with 12+ years across frontend, backend, and infrastructure. Runs
> fixed-scope technical audits, ongoing fractional CTO advisory, and team
> training for engineering organizations. Creator of The Imposter Engineer,
> where she publicly documents her methods and trains engineers into the
> industry.

Erica Thompson helps companies find and fix what's broken in their
codebases, provides ongoing technical leadership as a fractional CTO, and
trains engineering teams. Work is scoped and measured in outcomes, not
hours billed. She does not staff hourly feature development.

## Services

- [Technical Audit](https://ericathompson.io/#engagements): Fixed fee,
  fixed scope. Root-cause analysis across security, architecture,
  accessibility, and performance, delivered as a prioritized remediation
  roadmap. $7,500 (1 week) to $12,500 (2 weeks).
- [Fractional CTO Advisory](https://ericathompson.io/#engagements): Ongoing
  retainer covering architecture reviews, technical strategy, hiring
  guidance, and AI enablement. From $4,000/month.
- [Team Training & Workshops](https://ericathompson.io/courses):
  AI-assisted engineering workflows, accessibility, frontend architecture,
  and engineering judgment, delivered remote or on-site. Half day $3,500,
  full day $6,000, custom multi-session series from $12,000.

## Key pages

- [About](https://ericathompson.io/about): Background, track record with
  specific shipped outcomes, technical skills, and client/mentee
  testimonials.
- [Field Notes](https://ericathompson.io/blog): Long-form writing on
  technical audits, compliance engineering, migrations, and engineering
  career growth, drawn from real engagements.
- [Projects](https://ericathompson.io/projects): Selected shipped work.
- [Workshops & Speaking](https://ericathompson.io/courses): Workshop
  curriculum and conference talks.
- [Contact](https://ericathompson.io/contact): Direct contact methods and
  a message form.

## About the author

Self-taught engineer, 12+ years across InsurTech startups to HashiCorp.
Trained 500+ engineers into the industry, including 100+ veterans and
military spouses, at an 80%+ placement rate, through The Imposter
Engineer (https://www.youtube.com/@TheImposterEngineer).
